Uses and Administration Midazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine with gen- eral properties similar to those of diazepam (p.992), ex- cept that it has a more potent amnestic action. It is mainly used for sedation (p.956) in minor surgical or investigative procedures and in intensive care, for pre- medication, and for induction of general anaesthesia.
